name: commons-take-to-hand-v1
description: ⭐ DEAN'S VARIANT (09/09/2026), PUT TO THE ENGINE SESSION IN THESE WORDS: "Your bonus action can be to place 1 card in the centre [and take that board's action], OR take all the cards on one pile (without playing a card). If you take the pile of cards, instead of going into the barn, they go into your HAND. So we remove the rule that a harvest takes the cards from one central card. Effectively we change the bonus action into a draw instead of a harvest." rules.turn.commonsTake: 'bonus'. THE SHIPPED RULE IS 'harvest' (C5): a central pile is reached only through the Harvest action, whole pile into the harvester's BARN, and this overlay is paired against it - it sets no other knob, so every other rule in the game is exactly the shipped commons and the whole delta is this one flag. TWO CHANGES, NOT ONE. (1) HARVEST NEVER REACHES THE CENTRE: harvestOptions returns own full buildings only, so the wheat board is offered only when the seat already has one of its own, and rules.economy.commonsHarvestMin and rules.economy.commonsHarvestTake both have no subject under this arm - a pile is never gated on depth and never capped on the way out, because Harvest cannot reach it at all. (2) A NEW FREE BONUS MOVE, commonsTake { seat, board }, takes the WHOLE of one central pile straight to the taker's HAND: no card played, no fee, no action bought. It is the bonus slot's other half under this knob, on the same footing as the free Draw 1 under 'card' and Collect under 'meeple' - a free option sharing the slot with the paid commons play - so it carries the SAME solitaire-law question every previous currency has been measured on, arriving under a new name. It counts as a bonus use exactly as a commons play does: with A Helping Hand's second slot a seat may play twice, take twice, or one of each, never three, and under bonusTiming 'start' (the shipped order) it is only ever offered before the main action. ⭐ WHAT TO READ. a17-bonus-mix now prints THREE columns under this arm - PLAY (paid) / TAKE (free) / SLOT UNSPENT - and the verdict stays Dean's 30%-60% band, read on the slot's TOTAL use (play or take together), because his sentence was about the slot being spent at all and not about which half did the spending. A new detail line, "the free option's share of used slots", watches the same solitaire law that decided every previous currency this project has shipped (a free option must not crowd out the paid one) but carries NO VERDICT here - Dean set a band for the total, not for the split, so a high free share is OBSERVE rather than FAIL. a18-commons-traffic's harvest-side readings - central harvests, the harvest histogram, the wheat-board split - all read 0 or 'no subject' BY CONSTRUCTION under this knob, and are replaced with takes per player per game, the take-size distribution (1/2/3/4/5+, mean, median, p90, max), and the conservation line re-derived as plays = TAKEN out + stranded (never harvested out, because nothing is ever harvested out of the centre under this arm). The farm-bypass reading moves from the barn to the HAND: it reads 0% centre-to-barn by construction, and the number to read instead is cards taken to a hand from the centre, against cards drawn from decks per game where that count exists. ⚠️ TEN CARD FACES THAT READ ON A CENTRAL HARVEST ALSO HAVE NO SUBJECT under this arm for the identical reason commonsHarvestMin and commonsHarvestTake do: nothing is ever harvested off a central pile, so any rider keyed to that event never fires here. This is UNRUN before this pass.
